function.name: postsider_list_connectors
function.description: List connected social channels and their authorization/capability status.

function.name: postsider_list_channels
function.description: List the connected social channels for this organization. Returns each channel's id, name and platform. Call this before postsider_create_post to get a valid channel id for posts[].integration.id.

function.name: postsider_create_post
function.description: Create, schedule, or immediately publish a post across one or more channels. Forwards directly to POST /public/v1/posts.

function.name: postsider_list_posts
function.description: List posts scheduled or published within a date range (UTC).

function.name: postsider_get_connector_analytics
function.description: Get analytics for a connected channel (requires the ANALYTICS token capability).

function.name: postsider_find_slot
function.description: Get the next free scheduling slot for a channel, per its posting queue.

function.name: postsider_upload_media_from_url
function.description: Download an image or video from a URL into the media library and return the resulting media object.

function.name: postsider_get_post_missing_fields
function.description: Get per-channel validation problems for a post before it can be published.

function.name: postsider_request_approval
function.description: Send a draft post into the human approval queue.

function.name: postsider_get_approval_status
function.description: Check the approval status of a post that was sent for human review.
